description: Playwright-backed browser automation from main chat: open, read, click, type, screenshot, reuse-vs-duplicate.

turns.send: Open this URL with open_browser_page (forceNew true): {{fixture_file_url}}. Reply with the pageId only.
On the browser page you just opened, call read_page ONLY (do not use read_file or open_browser). Report the document title and whether you see a button labeled "Run test action".
On that same page, use click_element to click the "Run test action" button, then read_page again and confirm the result area shows "Action completed".
Type harness-ok into the test input field with type_in_page, then read_page and confirm the typed text appears in the page state.
Take a screenshot_page of the current browser page (same pageId). Say "screenshot captured" when done.
The user wants to see the harness fixture again. Reuse the existing shared page — do NOT call open_browser_page again. Only read_page to confirm the title.
